Create a users table with columns: id (uuid), accountId (uuid, foreign key), email (text, unique), role (text), invitedAt (timestamp with timezone), acceptedAt (timestamp with timezone, nullable). Add an accounts table if you do not have one yet: id (uuid), name (text), subscriptionStatus (text), billingEmail (text), seatCount (integer), createdAt (timestamp with timezone). Gate invoice creation behind a seat limit check in the domain layer so free accounts cannot create invoices until they subscribe.
